name: std/base
description: Shared cross-cutting primitives recovered from the misc pile: input events, dynamic strings, lightweight class/log helpers, an event framework, 16.16 fixed-point.
residual: Members were selected as high-fan-in AND low-fan-out (true foundation). High-fan-in HUBS were deliberately excluded because they also fan out into higher tiers and belong there, not in base: Configuration/Localization (pull XML -> std/web), Codecs (pull Raster -> std/gfx, SoundDevices), Repositories/Models (pull XML + WMEvents -> std/web + std/gui), Types (pull Texts -> std/text).
Candidate additions pending confirmation they stay runtime-only: none outstanding in this batch.
